description: Horaires et Fréquence Metro Lille - GTFS is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Thomas Pocreau. GTFS data from Lille metro. Data containing the start and end times of the services of the two metro lines and their frequency during the day. Variations for Sundays and public holidays are taken into account. The shapes come from OSM:. Coverage: Thomas Pocreau. The portal shows the English title as "Schedules and Frequency Metro Lille - GTFS" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Thomas Pocreau. Its keywords include horaires, metro, transpole, lille, gtfs, transports-en-commun. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GZ. The listing shows 2016-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
